title: I know almost everybody claims that they've...
content: Been having these MallWorld dreams "all their life" or for the last few decades etc but that's literally NOT the case for me. 🤷🏽‍♀️ I've only recently (like within the last few years) started having these types of dreams even though I'm a vivid dreamer, dream every single night & keep a dream journal etc but I wonder what sparked these reoccurring dreamscapes for me personally. Is this also a "newer" phenomenon for anybody else & do you have any theories on what might have triggered them to occur in the first place? For some reason I strongly feel like our cellphones might have something to do with it but there's people on here that say they've been having these dreams even before the internet was a thing so idk..
